Got this bed about four months ago and it's held up great against daily digging and rough naps from my 65-pound pup. Fabric hasn't frayed at all. Foam still feels supportive, not flattened. Easy to wipe down too. Honestly surprised how well it's lasted.

My little pup hates the cold, but this fleece is a game changer. The snug fit around the chest keeps drafts out, and the zipper makes it so easy to get on and off. Plus, the bright turquoise color makes her easy to spot at the park.

I really thought this would at least slow my German shepherd down, but he didn't even notice it was there. Feels flimsy and way too low to the ground. Complete waste of money for anyone with a bigger pup.

I honestly didn't expect much after so many failed attempts with pricier stuff, but this actually worked. Within days my dog's flaky belly cleared up and the constant licking stopped. It's gentle, smells mild, and a little goes a long way.

My rats took to this thing instantly. The bendable design let me create a little bridge between platforms, and it stays put once tightened. I was worried about chew damage, but it's held up perfectly after weeks of daily scrambling. Super sturdy and easy to clean.

My dogs love the durable nylon material, and these bones have survived months of heavy chewing without splintering. They're easy to rinse off after muddy yard sessions, and the vanilla scent keeps them coming back for more.

I ordered this thinking it would fit my cockatiel's cage setup, but it's just too bulky. The build quality seems decent for the price, though the size really caught me off guard. It's functional, but I wish the dimensions were clearer in the listing before I bought it.

I expected something basic for the price, but this bag is way roomier than I thought. The stitching is solid and the zipper glides without snagging. It easily holds my phone, treats, and a rolled-up leash. Honestly, I wish I'd bought two from the start.

Arrived a day early in perfect, secure packaging, no dents or damage. Opened it up and could immediately tell it's well-made, sturdy materials and smart design. First use went smoothly and my dog took to it right away. Really impressed so far.

The jar arrived super fast, double-wrapped in bubble cushion so no dents or leaks. Popped it open right by the box, smells so fresh, like a subtle herbal blend, not fake at all. First day it already cut the usual ammonia tang. Really impressed so far.

For the price, I expected way more than a disposable bowl. The silicone split along the seam after just one trip. Total waste of money, and now I have to buy a replacement before our next hike. Cheaply made and definitely not built to last.

I really wanted to like this mat but it barely lasted a few hours. The edges started fraying the second my pup pawed at it, and by evening it was shredded. For the price, I expected way better durability. It's a shame because the sizing was spot on for his space.

My tiny terrier mix is super picky about clothes, but this one doesn't ride up or bug her. The lightweight fabric is great for warmer walks. I'd totally suggest it for small, slim pups who hate bulky gear.

I wish I'd bought this sooner for my 70-pound husky. Walks are totally manageable now, even past squirrels. Definitely recommend it to anyone with a strong puller or reactive dog, it gives you real control without hurting them. Just pair it with a harness and some patience during the adjustment phase.

My pups go crazy for these, but they're gone in under ten minutes. For what I paid, I expected way more chew time. The price doesn't match how fast they disappear. I'll probably look for a bulk option next time instead of buying these again.

The extendable handle is a game-changer, no more bending down. The rake teeth grab everything cleanly off gravel, which was always a hassle before. Assembly took two minutes. Honestly wish I'd bought this years ago, it makes yard cleanup weirdly satisfying.

My picky senior cat cleans her bowl every time with this pate. I'd suggest it for anyone whose cat needs a smooth, easy-to-digest meal. The price is fair, and the subscription saves me last-minute store runs. Only wish the cans were a little bigger.

Got this for my black Lab so cars could spot her on late walks. The stitching's fine and it's held up, but the reflective strip is pretty narrow, doesn't pop as much as I'd hoped. Might work better for a smaller, light-colored dog who's already easy to see.

Got this blue collar a few months back and it's held up through daily walks, rain, and my dog's rough play. The embroidered info is still crisp. Only nitpick is the "gold" thread leans more mustard, but the collar itself feels sturdy and barely shows wear.

Got this little banana for my cat three months ago and it's held up great despite daily kicking and bunny kicks. The stitching hasn't split at all and the felt still looks fresh. My guy drags it around by the stem constantly. Solid toy for the price.

This plant is fine overall, the plastic isn't flimsy and it doesn't float up, but the colors looked way more washed out in person than online. It's just okay sitting in my betta tank. Not terrible, but I probably wouldn't order another one.

I wanted to love this for the price, but it's just not a good value. It seems to chop the topcoat instead of grabbing loose fluff, so my dog's fur ended up looking choppy and uneven. For under ten bucks, I guess you get what you pay for. Disappointing.

I got this after my vacuum started choking on cat fluff daily. For the price, it's a steal compared to those $30 brushes. My longhaired tabby acts like it's a spa treatment, and I pull off a whole extra kitten's worth of fur each session. Totally worth every penny.

For the price, I wasn't expecting miracles, but it's been solid on fleas so far. Found one tick on my lab a day after spraying, which was a bummer, but overall the bottle's huge and goes a long way. Smell is mild and didn't bother my cats at all. Decent bang for your buck.

For under twenty bucks, I wasn't expecting much, but this thing is solid. Setup took maybe two minutes and my finicky cat hopped right in. Cleaning is stupid easy now, no more scrubbing a filthy box. Honestly saves me so much on litter too. Best pet purchase I've made in years.

The clippers worked great for the first few weeks, but now they're super inconsistent. Battery life is decent and they feel nice in hand, but the blade snags constantly no matter how much I clean or oil them. It's a gamble every time I groom my dog, sometimes smooth, sometimes a choppy mess.

I honestly expected these to be just okay, but they blew me away. The stitching is rock solid and the material still looks brand new after months of daily use. My dog drags his around constantly and it hasn't torn or lost its shape at all. Seriously impressive quality.

I honestly didn't expect much at this price point, but it's rock solid. Assembly took maybe five minutes, and the height adjustment actually stays put. My Great Dane drinks without straining her neck now, which was the whole point. Way sturdier than the flimsy bowl stands I've tried before.

Bought these on a whim and my pup absolutely loves them. She gets all wiggly the moment I reach for the container. Her coat looks shinier and she seems more energetic lately. No tummy issues at all. Super easy to sprinkle on her food. Really happy we added these to her routine.

I was honestly a little skeptical at first because my cat destroys toys in a day, but this thing has held up way beyond what I expected. Stitching is solid and it still looks new after weeks of rough play. Definitely punches above its weight for the price.

My Lab mix destroys everything in under an hour, but this thing is still going strong after eight months. No shredded bits, no dead squeaker, just solid fun. I've already told a few friends with power-chewing pit bulls and shepherds to grab one, it's the real deal for heavy-duty play sessions.

My pit mix goes through chews like crazy, but these braided bully sticks actually keep her busy for days. The braided texture makes her work harder, and I love that they don't splinter or stink up the room. Pricey but worth it for the peace and quiet. Already ordered another pack.

I really like how the raised edges keep kibble from scattering everywhere, it's saved me so much sweeping. The silicone feels durable and doesn't slide around on my tile floor. My only small complaint is that it's not quite big enough to catch all the splash from my very enthusiastic Labrador's water bowl.

I picked up the medium for my 45-pound pit mix, and the fleece lining is ridiculously soft, she literally falls asleep in it. The high collar gives great wind protection on walks, and the buckles feel solid, not flimsy at all. For the price, I was honestly surprised by how well-made it is. Definitely a keeper.

Had this crate about four months now, and the corners are starting to look rough. The coating is flaking off near the bottom tray, and one door hinge is getting loose enough that it sticks when my dog leans against it. It's still functional, but I expected it to hold up better over time for the price.

I've had this running in my 40-gallon tank for over three months now and it's held up great through water changes and accidental bumps. The temp stays steady, no weird resets, and the display is easy to read at a glance. Suction could be stronger, but a little tape fixed that permanently. Solid little unit.

I actually love these for what they are. Perfect for a hospital tank or a quick quarantine setup where you just need something cheap and functional. I keep a pack on hand for emergencies and they've never let me down. If you're a betta keeper on a budget, these are a solid little workhorse.

My package arrived crushed with the treat bag torn open inside the box. Bits were scattered everywhere and the supposedly soft flowers felt like stale pebbles right out of the mail. My pup sniffed and walked away. First impression was awful, and the packing job didn't help. Total waste.

I wanted to love this bed, but the stuffing is weirdly crunchy and lumpy. I'd only suggest it to someone who's planning to restuff it themselves anyway. After a day, sharp little pieces started poking through the fabric, so my pup wouldn't settle. Ended up replacing all the fill.

My go-to for keeping the tank crystal clear. The floss pads are noticeably plush and trap debris way better than the flimsy ones that came with the unit. I'd recommend this combo to any aquarium keeper who hates frequent water changes. Having the carbon on standby is a nice bonus too.

I was honestly a little skeptical ordering dog food online, but this totally beat my expectations. My picky terrier cleans her bowl every single meal, and the case arrived in perfect shape with no dented cans. Way less hassle than running to the store and finding empty shelves. Definitely switching to this from now on.

I was surprised how fast this arrived, packed snug with no leaks or damage. Right out of the box, everything felt clean and professional, which gave me a lot of confidence. My skittish rescue took to it immediately, no fuss. Seeing her eyes clear up and her energy bounce back within days was honestly a relief. Really solid first impression all around.

I ordered the "large" size for my tegu and it's a joke. The stitching popped the second he flexed, and the material feels like cheap ribbon. He wriggled free in under ten seconds flat. Absolutely zero control, total waste of money. If you have any reptile bigger than a gecko, skip this entirely.

I picked this up hoping it'd blend in better with our living room than those clunky wire kennels, and looks-wise it definitely delivers. The fabric's nice and the zipper glides smoothly, but the frame isn't as sturdy as I expected for the price. My 40-pound pup leaned against one side and I could see the bars flex a bit. It works fine for calm indoor use, just don't count on it for anything beyond that.

This little breeder box is a solid choice if you've got livebearers like guppies or platys and want to keep the adults from snacking on the newborns. I wouldn't trust it with anything super determined, but for most community fish it gets the job done. The dual setup is handy, I keep mine floating. I'd recommend it to casual breeders who just need a simple, no-fuss nursery.

For under $15, this leash is a solid pick. The padded handle feels nice and the material hasn't frayed even after daily walks through wet grass and mud. The clasp started getting a little sticky around month three, but a quick spray with silicone lube fixed it right up. Totally fair for what I paid.

I've got a senior cat who kicks litter everywhere, and this mat catches most of it. The texture is grippy enough that the granules don't scatter across the floor. I'd recommend it to anyone with a tidy, smaller cat or a low-traffic area. If your cat is a major digger, you might still find some stray bits.

My skeptical cat figured this out in two days and now sprints to it at treat time. I honestly thought she'd ignore it, but she works the sliding covers like a tiny engineer. It's sturdier than I expected and way more engaging than her old puzzle feeder. Quick rinse and it's clean, no weird nooks trapping gunk.

I've been using this probiotic for my senior dog who's had loose stools for weeks. It mixes easily into wet food and she doesn't seem to notice it's there. After about 10 days, her digestion really settled down. I'd recommend it for anyone with an older pet dealing with gut issues, just wish the scoop was a little easier to find in the jar.

Finally got the right kit on my third try, worth the headache. Used it for three months now on old set-in stains and the enzyme formula hasn't degraded at all. Bottle's held up fine after multiple uses, no leaks or clogs. My carpet looks way better than I expected. Just double-check your shipment when it arrives.

My cat has always been picky, but these crunchy Greenies treats are a total game changer. She begs for them every morning and they've completely solved her hairball problems. No mess, no fuss, and she's so much more comfortable now. I'm honestly impressed with how well they work. Will definitely keep buying these regularly.

My 85-pound shepherd mix is rough on everything, but this stuff holds up. Applied it three months ago and even after countless lake swims, muddy hikes, and heavy rain, she's still tick-free. Found a dried-up one on the floor last week, so I know it's working. The value is incredible compared to what I used to pay at the vet.

I grabbed the variety pack hoping it'd keep my picky terrier interested, and honestly they've exceeded what I expected. The texture is softer than I anticipated, which makes breaking them into tiny pieces super easy for quick rewards. No weird smell either, just a mild bacon-y scent. He whines at the cabinet now whenever he sees me grab my treat pouch.

Arrived super fast and the box was pristine, no dents or cracks at all. Unwrapping it felt solid right away, sturdy but not too heavy. The light blue color looks even better in person. The removable food/water dish on top is a nice touch, and the waste tray already gives me peace of mind for longer drives with my anxious cat. Really happy with this purchase.

These arrived a day early and were packed in a sturdy little box, which I always appreciate for pet stuff. The container was sealed tight, so the treats smelled fresh right when I popped it open. My cat came running the second he heard the lid crack. I'm giving four stars only because I'd prefer a slightly softer bite, but overall a solid first experience.

My old dachshund took to this ramp right away, no hesitation at all. Assembly was basically zero, just unfolded it and we were done. The carpet surface gives her solid traction even when she's moving a bit slow in the mornings. It tucks neatly beside my dresser when not in use. Honestly wish I'd bought it sooner.

This cat hammock is a decent idea but really depends on your setup. I attached it to my kitchen chairs and the fabric just droops into a deep saggy pouch instead of a flat resting spot. My cat sniffed it once and never went near it again. Maybe it works better with extra-wide chairs or a crate, but for standard furniture it's pretty useless.

The box arrived crushed and the heater itself was loosely rattling around with zero protective padding. Right out of the package, the suction cups were deformed and wouldn't stick to the glass at all. The plastic casing already had visible scuffs like it had been used before. Honestly, my first impression was so bad I don't even trust plugging this thing in near my tank.

I was a little skeptical at first because of how affordable this was, but honestly it's been such a solid buy. The size is perfect for our tiny laundry room, and it traps almost all the scattered litter my cat flings around. No more sweeping three times a day. Easy to wipe down too. For the price, I genuinely wasn't expecting something this sturdy and well-designed.

This carrier looks and feels way more premium than I expected for the price. Assembly was a workout, those side rods really fight back, but once it clicked into place, it felt solid. My cat actually seems less stressed in it compared to the old plastic crate. The mesh is breathable and the padding's a nice touch. Only downside is zipping it shut while wrangling a squirmy feline. Overall, really happy with it.

I was skeptical because of the price, but honestly this thing pays for itself in saved paper towels and sanity. My puppy caught on within a day and now actively runs to the spot hoping for a payout. It's held up great outdoors in rain and sun, and the treat compartment seals tight so nothing gets stale. For under twenty bucks, you can't beat the convenience and fast results.

My two big dogs normally go crazy for dental sticks, but these were a total fail. Half the bag arrived crushed into crumbs and dust. The ones that were intact had a weird, stale smell I've never noticed before. Neither dog would touch them, which never happens. They literally sniffed and walked away. For what I paid, getting unusable, rejected treats is just frustrating. Waste of money.

I picked these up on a whim because the price per bag was way better than what I'd been paying for smaller training treats. For the amount you get, it's honestly a steal. My picky terrier goes nuts for the mixed flavors and the soft, chewy texture makes them easy to break apart. No weird smells, no tummy issues, and the resealable pouch keeps them fresh. Great everyday value.

My kitten's been on this stuff for about four months now and it's holding up great in the cupboard, cans never arrive dented, lids seal tight. Even when I forget to use a cover, the leftovers stay moist overnight in the fridge without drying out. She's a messy eater but the pate texture doesn't crust up in the bowl if she takes a break mid-meal. Still her favorite, every single time.

I'm honestly impressed by how quiet the motor is, my skittish rescue cat didn't even flinch when it started zipping around. The unpredictable spin pattern keeps her fully engaged without me having to dangle anything. After weeks of daily use, the feather attachment hasn't shed a single strand. I also love that it doesn't slide under the couch like other toys. Worth every penny for the sheer entertainment.

My 85-pound pit mix annihilates every chew in minutes, but this one has held up for weeks now. She's obsessed and her breath has seriously improved. I'd recommend it to anyone with a power chewer who's given up hope. Just watch your step, after a good gnaw session it gets rough on bare feet. Still, totally worth it for the peace and quiet.

Order arrived two days early in a sturdy box with zero damage, bags were sealed tight and super fresh. Right out of the package, the kibble smelled clean and slightly smoky, not greasy at all. My picky husky dove in immediately, which almost never happens with new food. After the first week, her coat already looks less dusty and she's scratching way less. Very happy with how quickly this shipped and the quality right from the first scoop.

I have a senior Chihuahua mix who had breath so bad I'd flinch when she yawned. After about a week of these chews, the brown buildup near her gumline started flaking off and her breath is way milder. She's picky but gobbles these right up. I'd recommend them to anyone with small dogs or older pups who struggle with dental chews that are too hard.

I'm honestly baffled by this bed. Within ten minutes of putting it down, both my pups started shredding it like it was a stuffed toy. The cover material seems to trigger some kind of prey drive, I've never seen them act this way with any other bed. Stuffing was everywhere in under an hour. I'd only recommend this to someone who wants an expensive, single-use destructible toy for their dogs, not an actual place to sleep. Total waste of money.

Got this for my pup who's obsessed with splashing through every muddy puddle we pass. It's held up great, no fraying or weird smells even after repeated dunkings. The clip feels really secure, and I don't worry about it accidentally detaching mid-walk. Cleaning is a breeze, just a quick rinse and it looks new again. Lightweight enough for daily use but tough enough that I'd trust it with a much bigger dog too.

Tried this on my wooden kitchen counters for a month. At first, the cats avoided it, which gave me false hope. By week three, the edges started peeling up and collecting dust and fur. Now it barely sticks to the surface but leaves behind a gummy residue that's a nightmare to scrub off. My youngest cat just walks right over it without flinching. Waste of money for anything beyond a few days of mild deterrence.

I was honestly nervous ordering a glass tank online, but the packaging was incredible, thick foam, reinforced corners, and zero damage. It arrived a day early too. Unboxing felt premium, and the tank itself looks way better in person. The front ventilation strip is a nice touch, and the top mesh gives great airflow. Setup was a breeze. Super solid first impression.

The box arrived a day early and was packed so well, no dents, no leaks, each can perfectly nestled. I cracked one open right away and honestly it smelled like something I'd put in a slow cooker for myself. Just a clean, real chicken scent. My picky little terrier trotted over before I even set the bowl down. He usually sniffs new foods forever but he dove straight in, tail going nuts. Clean bowl in under a minute.

I really wanted to love the cute paw print pattern, it looks adorable in photos, but the fabric is just too flimsy for actual use. My 45-pound dog isn't overly rambunctious, yet after three short rides, the stitching near the seat anchors started pulling apart. The buckles feel cheap and one already cracked. It's a shame because the design concept is great and the coverage fits my SUV nicely, but the materials can't hold up to normal wear. Disappointing durability for the price.

I grabbed these because the price was right and I go through rolls fast with two big dogs. They get the job done most of the time, but I've had a couple tear right at the seam when I'm pulling one off the roll. The material feels flimsy, so I always double-check before scooping. No major leaks yet, but I'm a little on edge every time I tie one off. Fine for light use, just don't expect heavy-duty reliability.

I've been giving these to my terrier for about three weeks now, and they're holding up way better than expected. Usually, crunchy treats get stale fast once the bag is open, but the resealable closure actually works and keeps them firm. She gnaws on them for a solid minute instead of inhaling them instantly. Only downside is she sometimes ignores them when she's in a mood, but that's just her personality. Good value overall, and I like that they don't crumble into dust at the bottom.

I really wanted to love the clean ingredient list, but after three weeks of daily use the pump completely gave out. The spring just collapsed and now I have to unscrew the top and scoop it out with a spoon, which is messy and wastes product. It worked fine at first but clearly isn't built to last through a full bottle. For the price, I expected way better durability. Bummed because the formula itself seems solid, just packaged terribly.

I wanted to love this mat, it caught a fair amount of litter at first, and the honeycomb pattern seemed smart. But after about six weeks of daily use with two cats, the edges started curling up and won't lay flat anymore. The material feels thinner than I expected, and cleaning it has become a hassle because litter gets trapped deep in the grooves. It's still functional, just not holding up as well as I'd hoped for the price.

I got this for my terrier mix who normally shreds anything with a squeaker in under ten minutes. She managed to tear open a seam on the wing pretty quickly, but the main body and that goofy giggling sound are still holding up after a week of rough play. It's not indestructible, but it's lasted way longer than expected. I'd definitely recommend it for moderate chewers who love auditory toys, just keep an eye on the stitching and maybe reinforce it early on.

I switched my sensitive-stomach pit mix to this after a ton of trial and error, and it's been a total game changer. No more itchy flaking or weird poop situations, just a soft, glossy coat and solid digestion. The price doesn't make you wince like most limited-ingredient formulas, which is huge if you're on a budget. I'd absolutely tell anyone with a rescue or a dog that struggles with grains to give it a shot.

I grabbed this cat tree hoping my two furballs would stop shredding the sofa, and honestly it's been a solid addition. Assembly was smooth for the most part, though I had to wrestle a bit with the top perch alignment, drill must've been off that day. Still, once it was up, both cats claimed it immediately and haven't looked back. The faux fur is soft and hasn't shed much, and the sisal posts are holding up against serious scratching. For the price, it's a cozy little tower that keeps them entertained. Just double-check those screw holes before tightening everything down.

I picked this up thinking it'd last maybe a couple weeks with our heavy chewer, but here we are months later and it's still going strong. She chomps on it daily, throws it around, and all it's got to show are some scuffs and teeth marks. For what we paid, I honestly expected way less durability. It's dense and sturdy without being weirdly heavy. Definitely worth every penny if you've got a dog that destroys typical toys in minutes. Just keep it off hard floors unless you enjoy surprise heart attacks.

My cat eventually started using this bed, but the whole experience was pretty mediocre. It arrived vacuum-sealed with a strange factory odor that took forever to air out, and the cushion never fully plumped up, leaving a lumpy, uneven surface. The heating element is barely noticeable even after hours of being plugged in, so don't expect cozy warmth. I ended up layering a fleece blanket on top just to make it somewhat inviting. For the price, I expected better quality and consistent heat. It's not terrible, but I wouldn't buy it again or recommend it enthusiastically.

I wasn't expecting these to last more than a week with my heavy chewer, but they've held up surprisingly well. The monkey is still intact after a month of daily thrashing. I like that the main body doesn't have a squeaker, it saves the toy from total destruction once he works through the limbs. He carries it everywhere and it hasn't split at the seams. Honestly thought I'd be picking up stuffing by day three. Definitely buying backups.

Got this harness way faster than expected, it showed up in like two days, packed in a simple but sturdy box with clear instructions tucked inside. First impression: the material feels super solid, stitching is clean, and the color was exactly what I ordered. Definitely took me a few tries to figure out the correct way to strap it on my wiggly pup, but once it clicked, it was smooth sailing. She seems comfy and doesn't fuss with it like past harnesses. Knocking off one star just because the sizing ran a tad small.

Great filters for the money, especially if you're someone who likes to tinker with your tank setup. I've been running these for months and they hold up really well. The best part is the cartridge size, it fits several different filter models, so I don't have to hunt down obscure replacements. I pop the carbon out before use and slide a Purigen bag inside instead, and it works like a charm. Saves me a ton compared to buying specialized media setups. Honestly, at this price point, you're getting a solid, versatile cartridge that does exactly what you need without breaking the bank.

The box arrived in two days with zero damage, and the toy was wrapped neatly inside without any weird smells or loose threads. First thing I noticed was how sturdy yet light the wand feels, my cat zeroed in on it before I even unpeeled the plastic. She batted at the felt end the second I flicked it and chased it around for a solid twenty minutes. Even my older cat perked up and joined in. Solid packaging, instant hit, no complaints.

This thing was a total waste of money for my situation. I have two strictly indoor cats and somehow fleas hitchhiked in on my jeans after a hike. Followed the instructions perfectly, treated the whole apartment, but the fleas just laughed it off. For anyone with a light, occasional flea sighting maybe it's fine, but if you've got an actual infestation brewing, skip it entirely. I'd only recommend this to someone who caught literally one flea on a white sock and panicked, otherwise you'll just delay real treatment. Ended up having to get prescription stuff from the vet anyway. My poor cats were miserable for an extra week because I trusted this.

My two Great Danes used to send their old bowls skidding across the kitchen floor every meal, but these are rock solid. The wide, flared rim catches stray kibble and keeps the whole thing from shifting even when they get enthusiastic. I went with black this time and it looks sleek tucked against the cabinet, no more ugly clatter. Cleanup takes about ten seconds since it's seamless with no crevices for gunk to hide. The height is a lifesaver for big dogs, no hunching or neck strain. Honestly, this is one of those simple purchases that makes daily routine way less annoying.

I've had this carrier for about four months, and the stitching along the top seam is already pulling apart. The mesh panel started fraying after maybe a dozen trips to the vet, and now there's a hole big enough for a paw to push through. The plastic clips that hold the shoulder strap feel flimsy, one snapped clean off last week when I picked it up with my 11-pound cat inside. The zipper pulls are cheap metal and keep bending out of shape. I thought it would hold up longer, but it's basically falling apart with normal, occasional use. Really disappointed I wasted my money on something so poorly made.

I keep a sponge filter like this ready for emergencies, but honestly it's so hassle-free I've started using it as a secondary unit on my 75 gallon setup. Setup is literally a minute, just attach an air line, plop it in, and it's running. The hum is barely noticeable, way quieter than my main canister. I ran it off a small battery pack during a recent storm and it kept my cycle alive for almost six hours with zero issues. For smaller tanks it would easily be a primary filter. The simplicity gives me peace of mind when I'm away from home. Great little workhorse.

My picky terrier usually sniffs a new treat and walks away, but the salmon scent of these had her dancing on her hind legs before I even peeled back the resealable strip. I love that they're squishy enough to tear into tiny training bits without crumbling into pocket dust. We've been using them for "stay" drills in the park, and her focus is laser-sharp now. No weird fishy after-smell on my hands either, which is a huge plus. Finally, a high-value reward that doesn't turn into a greasy mess in the treat pouch.

I wanted to love this since our other Kong toys hold up to my terrier mix's constant chewing, but this one popped a seam almost immediately. The size and shape are great for fetch, and the squeaker got her excited, but the fabric just isn't in the same league as their classic rubber stuff. I'd only suggest it for gentle chewers or small dogs who carry toys around more than they gnaw. If your pup likes to dissect plush toys, skip it. We'll stick with their extreme line from now on.

Got this for my 10-pound Chi mix about three months ago and it's held up really well. We've taken it on bumpy back roads and a long road trip, no loose stitching or cracks in the plastic at all. She wasn't sure at first, so I tossed her favorite small pillow inside and now she hops right in. The clip attaches easily to her harness and feels secure even when she shifts around. I use it in a Subaru Outback and the strap fits snug over the seat back. It's been through muddy paws and a spilled water bottle and still looks practically new after wiping it down. Very happy with how sturdy it's proven to be.

The box showed up looking like it had been drop-kicked across three states, half-crushed and barely taped shut. Opened it up and the ball itself was just rattling around loose inside with zero padding or even a plastic wrap. Already had scuff marks right out of the gate, which didn't exactly scream "indestructible." It's massive, way bigger than I pictured from the listing, and the material feels more like hard plastic than rubber. My German shepherd took one sniff, tried to mouth it for maybe ten seconds, and then walked off to chew a stick instead. Can't speak to long-term durability since he won't even acknowledge it exists now.

My 120 lb Cane Corso used to drag me down the street before we tried this. For under $20, it's honestly a steal compared to other head collars I've seen. It's super lightweight and easy to adjust, though the buckle feels a tiny bit flimsy for a dog this powerful. She still pulls when a squirrel pops up, but I can actually control her with one hand now. Walks are way less stressful for both of us, and my shoulder isn't sore afterwards. Definitely worth the money if you've got a strong puller.

I was honestly bracing myself for a beat-up box, but this thing arrived in pristine shape, no dents, no crushed corners, super snug packaging. Opening it was a breeze; no weird chemical smells, just fresh fabric and solid wood. First impression pulling it out: this is way sturdier than I expected. The base has real weight to it, so no wobbling when my chunky 17-pounder launched himself onto the top platform within seconds of assembly. He immediately started kneading the top cushion like he'd been waiting his whole life for it. Even the sisal rope winding looked tight and clean, not sloppy. Genuinely impressed right out of the gate.

I wanted to like these for my little Yorkie, but the sizing is completely off. Based on the chart, I ordered a medium, and it's so tight around his head that he freezes up and won't move. The visor part barely extends past his forehead, so I doubt it'll block any sun once we're actually outside. Material feels okay, but the velcro strap is super short and hard to adjust without catching his hair. For the price, I expected at least a functional fit. I'll probably just end up buying something else from a local store instead. Pretty disappointing overall.

My GSD mix can demolish a standard tennis ball in under two minutes flat, so I was skeptical about these. The squeaker is what really sets them apart, it's obnoxiously loud in the best way and keeps her engaged way longer than any silent toy ever has. She's been working on the same two balls for three weeks now, and while they're definitely scuffed up, neither has split open or lost its squeak. I appreciate that they have just enough give to satisfy her chomping instinct without falling apart. Fetch sessions in the backyard have gotten way more entertaining. If you've got a power chewer who lives for auditory feedback, these are absolutely worth grabbing.

Got this in the mail two days earlier than expected, which was a nice surprise. Packaging was solid, no leaks, box wasn't crushed, and the applicators were all sealed tight. First impression opening it up: the tubes feel a little flimsier than the pricey brand I used before, but they're easy enough to handle. I appreciated that the instructions were super clear, no tiny print guessing game. Applied it to my two cats yesterday and it dried quickly without leaving a greasy patch. No weird chemical smell either. Too soon to say how well it works on fleas long-term, but so far so good. Docking one star just because I wish the tubes were a tad sturdier.

I snagged the medium for my 45-pound cattle dog mix, and it arrived a day early in a slim padded envelope, no wasted plastic, which I liked. Right out of the pack, the fabric felt sturdy with no weird chemical smell, and the stitching around the D-ring looked clean and reinforced. The bell jingle is crisp but not obnoxious, and the colors are way more vibrant in person than on my screen. Sizing-wise, the medium fits her neck with about two fingers of wiggle room, so I'd say it runs just a touch snug, measure carefully. Overall, solid first impression for the price.

I've been using this collar on my terrier mix for about three months now, and it's held up way better than I expected. He's rough on gear, rolls in dirt, scrapes against the fence, even took a swim in the creek with it still on, and it's still working perfectly. The strap hasn't frayed, the buckle's solid, and the charge lasts longer than I thought it would. He learned fast to keep the barking in check, especially when the mail carrier comes by. My only tiny gripe is the prong covers could be a bit softer, but after this much daily abuse, the thing still looks and functions like new. Definitely sturdy enough for an active, stubborn pup.

This thing is massive for what I paid. I've got two budgies and they've basically got a condo now, plenty of room to hop around, stretch their wings, and have separate food stations without crowding each other. For the price point I was honestly expecting something flimsy, but the bars are sturdy and the tray slides out smoothly for cleaning. Assembly took me about forty minutes with a coffee break in the middle; the instructions are just diagrams but if you lay everything out first it clicks pretty quickly. All the perches and bowls included are basic but totally usable. If you're on the fence and want a spacious flight cage without dropping a fortune, this is a solid buy.

I've had this cat tree for about six months now with two rambunctious young cats, and it's held up really well. The scratching posts still look decent, no major fraying or wobbling, even with daily zoomies and wrestling matches. The platforms are sturdy and the whole thing stays put when they launch themselves onto it. Assembly was straightforward and it doesn't feel flimsy like some others I've tried. My only minor gripe is the inside of the cubbies isn't lined, just plain wood, so my cats tend to ignore those for napping. A little self-stick felt fixed it easily enough. Otherwise, it still looks nice in the living room and doesn't scream "cat furniture." Solid buy for the price.

Got this feeder back in October to deal with our chaotic feeding schedule. Honestly, I expected the adhesive to fail within weeks since our garage gets pretty humid, but it's still stuck solid on the wall after 7 months. The plastic hasn't warped or cracked either, even though my teenager isn't exactly gentle when refilling it. Only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is that the portion dial can be a little stiff to turn if you have wet hands, which happens more than I'd like. But overall, it's held up way better than I thought and keeps the dog food accessible without taking up floor space. No more double-feeding incidents either, so that's a win.

I really wanted to love this mat based on the description, but it's been a letdown. The honeycomb pattern looks deep enough in photos, but in reality it barely traps anything, most litter just skids right over the top or gets kicked off the edges. I have one cat and still find myself vacuuming constantly. Cleaning the mat itself is another headache; stuff gets wedged in the grooves and doesn't shake out easily. Also, after just a couple weeks, the material started curling at the corners and won't lay flat anymore. It's honestly not much better than a cheap bath mat, and for the price I expected something way more functional. Wouldn't buy again.

I was honestly shocked at how fast this thing arrived, it showed up two days early in a compact little box with zero damage. The packaging was simple but secure, no weird smells or loose threads when I pulled it out. It fluffed up almost instantly after unpacking, which was a relief because I was worried it'd need hours to take shape. My two ferrets sniffed it once and dove right in without any hesitation. The material feels soft but sturdy, and it's holding its shape even after a week of constant napping. First impressions totally exceeded my expectations, and watching them pancake together inside is the highlight of my day.

My 45 lb pit mix goes crazy for these, and for the price, they're a solid everyday chew. They don't last long for him either, maybe 5 to 7 minutes, but he's a moderate chewer, so that's fine for a quick distraction. I'd definitely recommend them to folks with smaller dogs or light chewers who just want a little treat that won't be gone in two seconds. Also great if you're training and need a high-value reward that's easy to portion out. Only downside is the occasional funky-smelling stick in the bag, which is why I'm giving four stars instead of five. Still, we keep a bag on hand all the time.

I've been using this crate for a few weeks with my border collie, and overall I'm happy with it. The plastic tray is sturdy and hasn't warped or cracked, even with my dog's occasional digging. Assembly was simple enough, and it feels secure once everything's locked in place. The wire isn't the heaviest gauge I've seen, so I wouldn't trust it with a strong escape artist, but for a medium-sized, calmer dog it's been just fine. I'd definitely recommend this to someone with a single pup who's already crate-trained or just needs a cozy den space. If you're planning to divide it for two puppies, the limited door access might frustrate you, but for my needs it works well.

I honestly didn't expect much from an online pet bowl order, but this thing is way heavier and better made than I imagined. The weight is perfect, my cat used to flip her old dish daily, and now she just stares at it like she's plotting revenge but gets nowhere. It doesn't slide on our tile at all, even when she paws at it. The finish is really sleek too, almost like something you'd put out for guests. Cleaning is super easy, no weird crevices where gunk builds up. For the price, I was bracing for something flimsy, but this feels like it'll last forever. Total win.

I was honestly impressed before I even opened the box. The package arrived a full two days early, wrapped snugly with no dents or leaks, always a relief with pet supplies. Inside, the bottle was sealed tight and cushioned well, so zero chance of a messy spill. First whiff told me it's got a mild, clean scent, nothing medicinal or overpowering. I tried a dab on my finger and it felt smooth, not sticky at all. My two terriers didn't flinch when I introduced it during their evening routine, which is a win because they're usually suspicious of anything new near their mouths. Already noticing less grime along the gumline after just a couple uses. Really happy I took a chance on this.

Got this goofy little guy for my 7-month-old terrier mix about three months ago, and it's still in one piece, which is saying something because she usually guts toys within a week. The stitching has held up great, no loose seams or stuffing explosions despite daily tug sessions and being dragged across concrete. The tummy squeak is weirdly endearing and still works perfectly. She loves pouncing on it to make the noise herself. It's also held its shape after countless rounds of fetch and getting slobbered on. I just toss it in the wash occasionally and it comes out fine. Honestly surprised by how tough it's been.

I picked this up hoping for a decent natural option that wouldn't break the bank, but honestly, for what you pay, I expected more. The ingredient list reads nice on the bag, but my dog's coat got dull after a few weeks and his energy seemed off. Poops were inconsistent too, sometimes soft, sometimes fine. It's not the worst food out there, but when I'm shelling out this much, I want to see him thriving, not just getting by. I'll finish the bag but probably won't reorder. There are better options in the same price range that actually deliver visible results. Feels like you're mostly paying for marketing.

I've had this thing for over six months now and it's holding up way better than I expected. I use it on my husky mix at least twice a week and the teeth are still sharp, no bending or dull spots at all. The handle hasn't loosened either, which I've had happen with pricier brushes. My dog actually leans into it now instead of running away, so that says something. Last week I filled an entire grocery bag with loose fur in one session and my couch finally looks normal again. I've dropped it on concrete a few times by accident and it barely has a scratch. For the price, I figured I'd get maybe a few months out of it, but it's honestly built like a tank.

I was honestly impressed before I even opened the bag. The packaging was really sturdy and sealed tight, no rips or weird smells, and it arrived two days early just tossed on the porch in perfect condition. My little guy was circling my feet the second I cut the bag open, he could smell it through the box, I swear. The kibble looks super fresh, nice uniform pieces with a faint hay-like scent, not dusty or crumbly at all. I poured a small scoop into his bowl and he did a full happy spin before diving in face first. First impressions are fantastic, and it's such a relief finding something that doesn't show up smashed or stale. Already feeling like this was a solid buy.

I picked this up for our 60-pound lab mix, not expecting much for the price, but it's honestly surprised me. The retraction is smooth, and the 4-meter cord gives him enough freedom without turning walks into a tangled mess. The lock button is really responsive, one quick press and he's secure, release and he's off sniffing again. The handle has this grippy, almost cushioned feel that doesn't dig in, even when he lunges at a squirrel. The flashlight was a bonus I didn't think I'd use much, but it's genuinely bright and makes late-night walks way less sketchy. Just grab some AAA batteries and you're set. For the cost, it feels sturdier and more comfortable than leashes I've paid double for.

I was honestly surprised how fast this arrived, ordered late Thursday night and it showed up Saturday morning in a compact, frustration-free box. No excessive plastic, just a neat little pouch with a care card tucked inside. Taking it out, the material felt immediately sturdy but not stiff or scratchy. The stitching is super clean, and the front clip ring has a solid weight to it, not flimsy at all. Slipped it on my 70-pound shepherd mix for a quick fit test and the adjustments were smooth; the buckles click in securely without pinching. First impression walking around the yard was night and day, he wasn't tugging, just trotted alongside me. It sits comfortably behind his legs, no rubbing under the armpits. Honestly, I'm kicking myself for not trying this sooner.

I was a little skeptical at first because my older cat is so picky, but this fountain won him over immediately. Setup took maybe five minutes and the pump is practically silent on my kitchen counter, just a gentle trickle that's actually kind of soothing. I love that it holds a decent amount of water so I'm not refilling it constantly. My cat drinks way more now, which was the whole goal, and I've noticed he's more energetic throughout the day. The materials feel sturdy and cleaning is straightforward. Honestly wish I'd grabbed one sooner instead of constantly running the bathroom sink for him. Total win for both of us.

I switched to this lightweight litter after years of hauling heavy buckets, and it's been a solid upgrade for my two senior cats. Scooping is way less of a chore now, the clumps hold together well and don't crumble when I'm digging around. There's noticeably less dust cloud when pouring, which my allergies appreciate. I'd definitely recommend it to anyone with mobility issues or back pain, since the lighter weight makes refills so much easier. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is that it does track a bit more outside the box than the traditional kind, so a good mat is a must. Still, for the convenience factor, it's worth it.

I was skeptical at first because the idea of a pinch collar seemed intense, but this thing has been a game changer for my 70-pound German Shepherd mix. He's friendly, just ridiculously strong and would drag me toward every squirrel in the neighborhood. The prongs look scary but they sit smoothly against his coat and he doesn't choke or gag anymore. Walks are actually enjoyable now, loose leash, no constant tugging. I'd recommend this to anyone with a big, enthusiastic dog who means well but doesn't know their own strength. Especially helpful for smaller-framed owners who need a little extra leverage without hurting their pup.

I really wanted to like this, but it's just poorly designed all around. The dimensions listed are misleading, my 4-pound puppy was squished in there with no room to turn around, and the neck opening is way too wide even when fully cinched. I wouldn't trust this with any dog that isn't basically a statue. Honestly, I'd only recommend it if you're carrying a stuffed animal, because it's absolutely not secure for a real pet. On top of that, the stitching around the main compartment started unraveling after one short trip to the vet. The mesh panel also feels flimsy, like it would tear if my pup leaned on it. Save your money and get something sturdier. This thing is a safety hazard.

I was hoping this would be a decent low-cost option for my turtle tank, but it's been a letdown. The temperature dial feels super flimsy and the numbers are hard to read, so I never really know what I'm setting it to. Even when I think I've got it dialed in around 80, the actual water temp hovers way lower, like 70 if I'm lucky. I've double-checked with a separate thermometer just to be sure. The suction cups are weak too, keeps falling off the glass overnight. I get that it's cheap, but I still expected it to hold a steady temp for more than a day without constant tweaking. Probably fine if you just need a backup, but definitely not reliable as a main heater.

My terrier mix is absolutely relentless when it comes to toys, and I've lost count of how many he's shredded within hours. This ball, though? Completely different story. From the moment I tossed it across the living room, he was hooked, bounding after it, pouncing, and rolling it around with his nose like a tiny soccer star. It's held up through weeks of daily abuse without any cracks or tears, and the erratic bounce keeps him guessing every single time. I love that he can entertain himself with it, which gives me a break while I'm cooking or working. It's easily the best purchase I've made for his playtime.

I've had this heater running in my 20-gallon freshwater tank for around four months now. When it works, it's great, holds temperature steady and the external adjustment dial is handy. But I've noticed it occasionally overshoots by a few degrees, usually after a water change. Last week it let the tank drift up to 86 before I caught it. The built-in thermostat seems a little inconsistent, so I added a separate controller for peace of mind. For the price, it's decent, but I can't fully trust it on its own anymore. I'd recommend keeping a close eye on your thermometer if you go with this model. It's okay, just not as reliable as I'd hoped.

I was a little skeptical trying this with my senior dog who turns his nose up at most wet foods, but for the price, it's a steal. The texture is soft and easy to mix into his kibble, and he actually licks the bowl clean every single time. I noticed it's not swimming in gravy like some brands, but honestly that doesn't matter because the meat itself is moist and smells decent. I just break it up with a fork and add a splash of warm water to stretch it further. Our vet commented he's maintaining weight better too. For what you pay, the quality really overdelivers. Will keep this in our regular rotation.

I was a little worried when the box showed up because it looked like it had been through a lot, but everything inside was wrapped securely and in perfect shape. The seat itself was super easy to unfold right out of the package, no weird chemical smell either, which I appreciated. First impression is that the material feels sturdy and the clips seem solid, not flimsy. My 13-pound terrier mix hopped in with zero hesitation and immediately curled up, so it clearly passes the comfort test. Only reason I'm not giving five stars is the instruction booklet was a crumpled mess and the diagrams were tiny, but setup was intuitive enough to figure out on my own. Overall, really pleased so far.

The sifting mechanism itself works pretty well and does a decent job separating waste, which is what I was most excited about. But the real issue for me is the size of the waste drawer, it's way smaller than I expected. With two cats, I'm having to empty it every other day, which kind of defeats the purpose of an automatic box. It also starts to smell quicker than I'd like, even with the little carbon filter they include. My cats adjusted fine and use it without problems, so no complaints there. I just wish the compartment was deeper so I could go longer between cleanings. For the price, I was hoping for something a little more low-maintenance.

These treats have been an absolute game changer for our three cats. I was honestly shocked by how excited they get the second the bag crinkles. The texture is super interesting, almost like a crunchy shell with a softer center that crumbles as they chew. I've noticed a real difference in their breath and the overall cleanliness of their teeth since we started using them regularly. No weird smells or greasy residue either, which is a huge plus for me. They're easy to break into smaller bits for our older cat who eats a little slower. It feels good giving them something they genuinely enjoy that also helps with dental health instead of just empty calories. Will definitely keep these stocked.

I got this lead mostly for neighborhood walks, and the length is perfect for giving my dog a bit of freedom without losing control. The real standout for me is the padded handle, it's super comfortable even when he pulls, and I don't get that awful rope-burn feeling after a long stroll. We've been using it daily for a few weeks now, and the stitching still looks brand new. The clip attaches smoothly to his harness and hasn't shown any signs of weakness, even with his sudden squirrel lunges. It's also surprisingly lightweight, so I can easily bunch it up in my hand when we're in tighter spaces. Honestly, this thing just works and feels well-made.

I've been using this vitamin supplement for my two ferrets going on three years now, and I'm honestly impressed by how well it holds up, no clumping in the container even after months, and the quality never dips. They still sprint to the bowl twice a day when they hear me shake the bottle, which says a lot. One of my boys had a dull coat and low energy when I adopted him, but within maybe six weeks of starting this, he slicked up and started causing his usual chaos. I split the daily amount into morning and night too, and it blends fine with their kibble without getting soggy or ignored. It's just one of those staples I don't second-guess reordering.

I've had this cot for about eight months now and it's honestly held up way better than I expected. My 75-pound lab basically lives on it during the summer, and it hasn't sagged or torn at all. I keep it outside on a covered patio, but it's been through some serious temperature swings and a few surprise storms with zero issues. The fabric dries quick and still looks new, no weird smells or mildew. Assembly took maybe five minutes out of the box. My dog took to it immediately, which is rare for him with new beds. Super solid, easy to hose off when it gets muddy, and the frame still feels rock solid. Definitely worth the price.

I was genuinely shocked. My 7-month-old Lab typically inhales his meals without a second thought, but he sniffed this kibble and literally backed away from the bowl. I even tried hand-feeding him, and he just let the pieces drop to the floor. My older border collie eventually nibbled a few bits, then vomited on the rug about an hour later. I can't justify the price when both dogs gave it a hard pass and one ended up sick. The ingredient list sounded impressive online, but real-world results in my kitchen were a complete letdown. Total waste of money and a pretty stressful evening for everyone involved.

I've got a giant breed dog who leaves behind what feels like horse-sized piles, and standard bags used to be a gamble every single walk. These are generously sized, so I'm not doing that awkward two-bag juggle anymore. The thickness gives me real peace of mind, no surprise tears, no gross warmth seeping through. I keep a roll clipped to the leash and a backup in the car because they're just that reliable. I'd especially recommend them for anyone with large dogs, mobility issues, or folks who simply refuse to risk a mess on their hands. Makes cleanup genuinely stress-free instead of a dreaded chore.

Our cat has always been obsessed with boxes, so I figured this little hideaway would be a hit. Assembly took maybe five minutes, and the material feels sturdier than I expected for cardboard. She dove in before I even finished setting it up and spent the next three hours napping inside. It's held up well to daily scratching and the occasional midnight zoomie collision, though one corner is starting to look a bit frayed after a month. I just wish it came in a slightly larger size since she's a bigger fluffball and has to curl up tight to fit. Still, for the price, it's a solid upgrade from the delivery boxes she usually claims.

Bought the 24-inch MidWest iCrate for my rescue Chihuahua mix after struggling with a flimsy wire crate that rattled every time she shifted. Honestly expected decent quality given the brand reputation, but it blew past that. The assembly took maybe five minutes with zero tools, and every connection locked in solid. No sharp edges, no wobble. The divider panel was a lifesaver during potty training, adjusted it twice as she grew. The plastic pan slides out smoothly and doesn't warp when I hose it down. My pup settled in faster than any dog I've crate trained before. Feels sturdy enough to last through future puppies. Seriously impressive for the price point.

I've had this cat condo for about a month now and the stability still surprises me. My two rambunctious boys launch themselves at it from across the room and it doesn't even wobble, which was my biggest worry. The base is really solid and the platforms are roomy enough that my chunky tabby can actually sprawl out without hanging off the edge. I did have to anchor it to the wall just for my own peace of mind, but honestly it probably didn't need it. The sisal scratching posts are thick and holding up great, no shredding yet. My cats basically live on the top perch now and ignore everything else I've ever bought them. Worth every penny.

I've been running the Hydor Professional 600 for a little over a month now and it's been a total game changer for my 75-gallon setup. The flow is strong but adjustable, and my water has never looked this crystal clear. Setup was surprisingly simple, everything clicked together without any fuss, and priming took maybe two minutes. It runs whisper-quiet too, which my living room appreciates. I love how easy it is to pop the baskets out for maintenance; no wrestling with stubborn latches or leaking seals. Fish seem happier, plants are thriving, and the overall stability has been rock solid. Honestly wish I'd upgraded sooner. Definitely worth every penny if you're serious about your tank.

I wanted to love this pouch, and for the most part it's a solid basic option for daily walks. The main compartment is roomy enough for treats, my phone, and a roll of poop bags without feeling bulky. What really let me down was the magnetic closure, it's a nice idea in theory, but it's just not strong enough. Anytime I bent down to leash my dog or pick something up, the flap would swing open and scatter treats everywhere. I lost half a bag of kibble on a trail last week. The belt clip is sturdy and the material cleans up easily, but that closure issue makes it frustrating to use. It's okay for calm, short outings, but not reliable for active walks or training sessions.

I'm honestly so impressed. The backpack arrived two days earlier than expected and the packaging was super tidy, no weird smells, no squashed parts, just neatly folded with clear instructions tucked inside. Right out of the box I could tell this wasn't some flimsy knockoff; the stitching is rock solid and the zippers glide like butter. I ordered the charcoal color and it looks even better in person. My little guy popped his head in out of curiosity while I was still unboxing, which never happens. The padding feels cushy but breathable and I love that there's a safety clip inside. First test walk around the block went way smoother than I braced for. Totally stoked to take him on longer adventures now.
